Well, imagine a spaceship landing on a lava planet and the only place is a castle on a hill.|Cavan Scott|{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2018-queens-shadow-revealed-and-more-from-the-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2018: ''Queen's Shadow'' Revealed and More from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}}} '''''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Cavan Scott]] that was published by [[IDW Publishing]]. The first issue was released on [[October 3]], [[2018]]. A sequel series, ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle]]'', was written by Scott and published in October [[2019]]. All five issues of ''Tales from Vader's Castle'', along with all five issues from ''Return to Vader's Castle'', were collected in the hardcover graphic novel, ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Beware Vader's Castle]]''.
